agent.problem: The opening card says only that something is coming, so the baker cannot reason out whether the answer is famine, war or plague. The blank asks for an unseen word from verse 1 rather than a meaning the baker can work out.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: Verse 3 says that the woman returned, but the card adds that she brought her household back home. The passage does not state or clearly imply that the household returned with her.

rule.text: Retelling: Papa Dorin can retell in his own words and fill in what the text clearly implies. Scene-setting details are fine. He never says anything the text shows is wrong.

agent.problem: The question depends on 'that story,' pointing back to card 11 instead of identifying Gehazi's account of Elisha bringing the dead back to life. The earlier card is no longer on screen.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
